title: Content Engine Automation Pipeline
description: Phase 1 schema: drives the Playwright recorder. A pipeline opens the target app once, waits for Pyodide, then walks an ordered list of scenes. Each scene targets its own pane / region and is later cropped to a vertical (mobile) clip.

name.description: Pipeline identifier, used in output folder/manifest naming.

url.description: URL opened once at the start of the run.

viewport.description: Desktop viewport the app is rendered at. The app is NOT made responsive; scenes crop sub-regions of this canvas.

waitForPyodide.description: Block until the Pyodide startup loader disappears before scene 1.

pyodideLoaderSelector.description: DOM node present while Pyodide is loading; recorder waits for it to detach.

readySelector.description: Optional extra selector to wait for (visible) after Pyodide, e.g. '#main-chart'.

readyTimeoutMs.description: Max time to wait for Pyodide / ready selector.

headless.description: Run without a visible window. CLI --headed / --headless overrides this.

timelineOffsetMs.description: Constant offset added to every scene's start/end when slicing the raw video, to compensate for encoder lead-in. Tune if clips look a few frames early/late.

settleMs.description: Default pause after a scene's setup actions before its region is measured (lets layout/animations settle).

resolution.description: Final clip resolution. Default is a 9:16 vertical frame for Reels / TikTok.

fitMode.description: How a scene's region is mapped to the vertical frame. cover = scale-to-fill + center-crop; contain = scale-to-fit + pad.

keepRaw.description: Keep the full-session raw video alongside the per-scene clips.

scenes.description: Ordered scenes. Recorded in one continuous session, then sliced + cropped per scene.

id.description: Unique scene id; becomes the clip filename (output/scenes/<id>.mp4).

setup.description: Actions run BEFORE the scene's region is measured and timing starts (e.g. open the right pane).

target.description: Which part of the desktop canvas this scene captures.

waitBeforeMs.description: Extra pause after measuring the region, before the scene clock starts.

durationMs.description: Minimum scene length, run concurrently with `actions`. The scene lasts max(durationMs, actions time) + holdAfterMs. Optional if the scene has actions, stopWhen, or holdAfterMs.

holdAfterMs.description: Static hold AFTER `actions` finish — e.g. let the final state breathe before the next scene.

stopWhen.description: Alternative to durationMs: end the scene when a selector reaches a state.

actions.description: Actions performed DURING the scene (while it is being recorded).

target.description: Region of the rendered app to crop for this scene. Provide exactly one of: selector, pane, paneIndex, region, fullViewport.

selector.description: CSS selector; the element's bounding box is captured. e.g. '#main-chart', '.react-flow'.

pane.description: Named pane shortcut; resolves to the pane's full panel box.

paneIndex.description: Zero-based index of a [data-panel] element in document order (left-to-right).

region.description: Fixed pixel rectangle within the viewport.

aspect.description: Optional 'W:H' ratio (e.g. '9:16'). Carves the largest sub-rectangle of that aspect from the resolved box — true vertical framing with no squish.

anchor.description: Where the `aspect` sub-rectangle sits within the resolved box. 'right' = anchored to the right edge.

padding.description: Shrink (positive) or expand (negative) the resolved box. Number = all sides, or per-side object.

type.description: press: keyboard combo (key=e.code like 'Digit1', plus shift/ctrl/alt/meta). type: type text into the focused element. fill: focus+clear+set an input by selector. click/rightClick/dblclick/hover: target by selector (optional `position` offset, `nth` for which match). wait: pause ms. waitForSelector: wait for selector state. scroll: wheel by deltaX/deltaY (optionally over selector). mouseMove: move cursor to x,y. eval: run a JS expression string in the page.

nth.description: Pick the Nth match of `selector` (0-based). Defaults to the first match.

position.description: Click point as an offset inside the target element (e.g. right-clicking empty canvas).
